limits: Previously used historical snapshots; not a fresh unseen final test or prospective deployment result.
One seed and fixed default base-model parameters. No joint tuning of model, calibration fraction or regularization.
Every map including identity uses the same smaller base-training prefix; these scores are not directly comparable with full-development refits in other reports.
Dirichlet-L2 uses scikit-learn C=1 coefficient regularization and an unpenalized intercept; no ODIR or original benchmark reproduction.
Temperature works on log probabilities floored at 1e-15 with T in[0.01,100]; it cannot repair class-specific biases independently.
Fixed-bin ECE is descriptive and bin-sensitive; selection uses proper log loss, with Brier/RPS and reliability retained.
XGBoost retains training-prefix class weights; logistic regression and calibration losses are unweighted.
No production models, live forecasts or database records are replaced. Private probabilities and IDs remain local.

provenance_revision.reason: Correct distribution metadata lookup: the installed package is xgboost-cpu, while the imported module is xgboost. The earlier absence statement was too broad.
